rules.textSv: Universiteit Gent och TU Bergakademie Freiberg Period Universitet Kursnamn Hp Nivå/Djup Område 1 Gent Introduction to the circular economy, economics and management of natural resources 4 A1N HU 1 Freiberg Problems and innovations in the process chain of mineral resources 4 A1N HU 2 Gent Sustainable systems engineering 5 A1N HU 2 Gent Sustainable development and multicriteria decision-making 3 A1N HU 2 Gent Rational Use of Materials 5 A1N HU 2 Gent Resource recovery and recycling technologies 5 A1N HU
rules.labelEn: Semester 1 is spent at Universiteit Gent and TU Bergakademie Freiberg taking introductory courses on circular economy, mineral resources, sustainable systems, and resource recovery.
Semester 2 is studied at Uppsala University.

rules.textSv: Studenterna läser 1MP032 och väljer en av 1HY042, 1MP034 eller 1MP018, eller 1MP001 i period 4.
rules.labelEn: Students take 1MP032 and choose one of 1HY042, 1MP034, 1MP018, or 1MP001 in period 4.

rules.textSv: Sommartermin (TU Bergakademie Freiberg) Period Universitet Kursnamn Hp Nivå/Djup Område Sommar Freiberg Resurskemi 9 A1N HU
rules.labelEn: Summer-term course Resource Chemistry (9 hp, A1N) is taken at TU Bergakademie Freiberg.

rules.textSv: Alla studenter läser gemensamt kursblock om 15 hp vid TU Bergakademie Freiberg, samt väljer fördjupningsspår under år 2:Gemensamt kursblock (TU Bergakademie Freiberg)* Period Universitet Kursnamn Hp Nivå/Djup Område 1/2 Freiberg SINReM Praktik 10 A1N HU 1-4 (year course) Freiberg Financial and sustainability reporting, financial planning and business valuation 5 A1N HU Kursen Financial and sustainability reporting, financial planning and business valuation ges på distans.
rules.labelEn: All students take a common 15-credit course block at TU Bergakademie Freiberg: a 10-credit SINReM internship (year-long, periods 1-2) plus the distance-taught course Financial and Sustainability Reporting, Financial Planning and Business Valuation (5 credits).

rules.textSv: Universitet Gent, TU Bergakademie Freiberg och Uppsala universitetStudenterna gör examensarbetet på samma lärosäte som fördjupningsspåret. Period Universitet Kursnamn Hp Nivå/Djup Område 3&4 Gent Master's dissertation (I002199) 30 A2E HU 3&4 Freiberg Master thesis in sustainable and innovative natural resource management 30 A2E HU
rules.labelEn: The degree project (30 hp, A2E) is taken at the same university as the student's specialisation track, with equivalent thesis courses at Ghent, Freiberg, and Uppsala.
